_note: PyreVixen default search configuration. DuckDuckGo is the default engine (no tracking, no filter-bubble profiling). Startpage, Brave Search, and Mojeek are offered as alternates — all privacy-respecting, none ad-profiled. Suggestions are OFF by default (keystrokes must not leave the device), sponsored suggestions are disabled entirely, and no engine ships a suggestion endpoint in this file. The user can enable suggestions per-engine in Settings; that choice is theirs, never a default.
